name: Hatuniye and Yali Boyu (Riverfront Mansions)
tagline: Ottoman mansions on the water, Amasya's postcard face
description: The riverside strip where restored yali konaklari half-timbered mansions line the Yesilirmak, many converted into boutique hotels, cafes, and guesthouses. It is the most walkable and photogenic part of town, with the rock tombs lit up across the water at night. Wifi cafes here are the closest thing to workspaces the town offers.
bestFor: short stays, photographers, first-time visitors, light remote work
cons: busiest and priciest area on weekends/holidays
can feel touristy in peak season

name: Harsena / Citadel Side
tagline: Beneath the rock tombs and hilltop fortress
description: The steep hillside area below Harsena Castle and the Pontic rock-cut tombs, mixing old stone houses with quiet residential lanes and hiking paths up to the citadel. Fewer tourist services but unmatched views over the gorge and mansions below. Best suited to those prioritizing scenery and quiet over convenience.
bestFor: hikers, long-stay residents seeking quiet, view-seekers

name: Ataturk Caddesi / Modern Center
tagline: Everyday Amasya: shops, banks, and practical living
description: The functional heart of town away from the tourist riverfront, home to grocery stores, pharmacies, banks, the market, and more modern apartment blocks with fiber internet. This is where most locals actually live and run errands, offering better long-term rental value and practicality than the historic core.
bestFor: longer-term stays, budget renters, those wanting local immersion
cons: further walk to main historic sites

name: Merzifon (nearby town)
tagline: The airport town, a quieter alternative base
description: A separate town about 45 minutes from central Amasya, home to Amasya Merzifon Airport and a more workaday, agricultural feel with historic Ottoman-era caravanserais and mosques of its own. Some long-stay nomads base here for cheaper rents and airport proximity, commuting into Amasya for sightseeing and cafe work.
vibe: small-town, agricultural, off the tourist track
bestFor: budget stays, frequent flyers, those wanting maximum quiet
cons: very little English or tourist infrastructure
